questions.qtext: Flywheels are fitted for single cylinder and multicylinder engine of the same rating. Which of the following statement is true?

options.text: The flywheel will be smaller for single cylinder engine as compared to that for multi cylinder engine.
The flywheel will be smaller for multi-cylinder engine as compared to that for single cylinder engine.
The flywheels for two engines will be identical.
The size of flywheel for an engine depends on the compression ratio.

questions.solution:
(b)
These will be less variation of turning moment in the multi-cylinder engine as compared to that for single cylinder engine.

questions.qtext: Which of the following is not an exact-straight line mechanism?
questions.solution:
(b)
Exact straight line mechanisms:
Paucellier mechanism, Hart mechanism, Scott-Russel mechanism, Kempe mechanism.
Approximate straight line mechanisms:
Modified-Scott-Russel mechanism, Grashopper mechanism, Watt mechanism, Tchebicheff
mechanism, Robert mechanism, etc.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements is/are correct?

options.text: Space centrode is the locus of I-centre of the moving body relative to the fixed body.
Body centrode is the locus of I-centre of fixed body relative to the movable body.
The plane motion of a rigid body relative to another rigid body is equivalent to the sliding motion of one centrode on the other.
If the motion of any movable link, results in definite motion of other links in a linkage then it is called as mechanism.

questions.solution:
(a, b, d)
The plane motion of a rigid body relative to another rigid body is equivalent to the rolling
motion of one centrode on the other.
